title: The Signature Approach to Context-Aware Spatial AI (Signature)
provenance: Signature original design work by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled original designs and improvements — original work, not presented as established public fact.
description: The Signature approach builds spatial AI privacy-first: on-device processing, open anchor standards, and assistive modes as first-class features. The spatial web belongs to everyone, not to whoever maps it first. This is Signature original work by Justin Addam Higgins: an original design direction for Context-Aware Spatial AI, labeled as Signature throughout, and never presented as established public fact. Signature spatial AI ships in glasses you forget you are wearing: the world labeled, navigable, and explainable — with mathematical privacy guarantees and open standards underneath.

Signature vision: Signature spatial AI ships in glasses you forget you are wearing: the world labeled, navigable, and explainable — with mathematical privacy guarantees and open standards underneath.
Original work: designed by Justin Addam Higgins, Signature-labeled throughout.
